objective.primary: Test whether a JANUS collision-guided classical order finder extracts the exact multiplicative order r substantially earlier than a full linear order scan on disjoint semiprimes.
objective.shor_core: Find minimal r>0 such that a^r mod N = 1, then optionally attempt gcd(a^(r/2) ± 1, N).
objective.claim_ceiling: Classical order-finding experiment only; no quantum speedup claim and no polynomial-time factoring claim.

roles.JUXTAPOSE: Issue diversified exponent probes x in deterministic waves.
roles.SPIDER: Hash/index residues a^x mod N and emit equality edges when residues collide.
roles.KEYMASTER: Aggregate collision gaps d=|x_i-x_j| using gcd and decide when an exact reduction attempt is warranted.
roles.EXACT_JANUS: Verify candidate multiples, reduce to the minimal exact order, and certify minimality.

algorithm.exponent_schedule: Deterministic PRNG without replacement over [0,N-1], seed = SHA256(arena_id|N|a), no holdout outcomes used.
algorithm.collision_fact: a^x == a^y (mod N) with gcd(a,N)=1 implies r divides |x-y|.
algorithm.candidate: gcd of all nonzero collision gaps observed so far.
algorithm.exact_reduction: Factor candidate by deterministic trial division; repeatedly test candidate/q with exact modular exponentiation for prime q; certify r by a^r=1 and a^(r/q)!=1 for every prime q|r.
algorithm.fallback: If no certified order is found before max_probes, return UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT; never infer absence.

baselines.LINEAR_ORDER_SCAN: Starting at residue 1, multiply by a modulo N once per step until residue returns to 1. Baseline total modular multiplications = r.
baselines.comparison_scope: Same N,a; factors p,q are not provided to the solver.

forbidden: treating an 8-wide JUXTAPOSE wave as one unit of total compute
using known semiprime factors to infer phi(N) or r
calling probe-count improvement alone a compute speedup

holdout.note: Only N and a are frozen here; no multiplicative orders or prime factors are stored in the holdout specification.

frozen_gates.G1_EXACT_ORDER_ALL_CASES: 32/32 JANUS orders equal independent linear-scan orders.
frozen_gates.G4_CASEWISE_TOTAL_COMPUTE_WIN_FRACTION: fraction of cases with JANUS total modular multiplications < r >= 0.70
frozen_gates.G6_NO_FACTOR_LEAKAGE: Solver interface receives only N,a and frozen public constants.
frozen_gates.G7_NEGATIVE_RESULT_IMMUTABILITY: Any failed gate remains failed; no threshold changes after holdout run.

scientific_boundary.expected_classical_scaling_hypothesis: Birthday-style residue collision may require O(sqrt(r)) residue probes; independent powmods add O(log N) modular multiplications per probe.
scientific_boundary.not_proved: No asymptotic theorem is inferred from finite benchmarks.
scientific_boundary.worst_case_warning: Since r can scale as O(N), O(sqrt(r) log N) remains exponential in input bit-length log N.
